positive_snippets: I had an amazing 14 days of experience. All the service offered were top notch from staff to cleanliness to food and delivery. Must visit and highly recommend.

The rooms were very neat and clean. Stayed for a wedding function. Breakfast buffet was upto the mark with variety and quality. The location of the property is well accessed as it is the road. Overall comfortable stay
negative_snippets:
Geaser didn't work, we called probably 6 times for help in our 9 day trip (17th-27 December). When they would come fix it either it won't work or will stop working overnight, promoting us to call again and again. The night duty guy and security gaurd were atleast nice about it, the receptionist girl who sits in the day is rude and gives one word replies to everything. We showered in cold water in biting December cold multiple times

The height of disgust was when I asked to switch rooms they said there isn't any but gave us the washroom of the room to use for hot water. They didn't mention it's a USED ROOM (pictures attached), it had alcohol in it and condom wrappers and no one bothered to clean once the customer checked out, they just sent us there to use cuz they had hot water. It was very hard to keep our temper in control. They literally told us to go to a different room to shower!! Someone else's USED ROOM

We asked over call for amenities like toilet paper that never got delivered multiple days. Housekeeping was apparently only in the hours of 12-5 when most people are out, where they suggested we just hand over our room keys for cleaning cuz they can't do it outside those hours. Laundry also is only 8am pickup and gets returned next day.

No info brochure or anything about these procedures. Their website says they have 24/7 kitchen which is a BLATANT LIE. it closes at 10:30. NO conference room either like the website says.

They didn't try to offer any reimbursement for the inconvenience either, no refund no waiving off the room service charge or anything.
Disgusting experience honestly, we should be entitled to full refund tbh but we didn't wanna haggle and even tipped the security guard.

Won't book here again.

When we checked in, I asked the reception to send our luggage to the room, but no one did. Then after i called reception after 2 hours and they replied sorry we forgot. There were also no towels in the room when we arrived, which was disappointing. Later, I requested room cleaning from the receptionist, Pooja, 2 times, but no one came. After the receptionist changed, I spoke to Tinku, and he immediately arranged for the cleaning. I really appreciate Tinku’s quick help, but the earlier service experience was quite poor. I hope the hotel improves its housekeeping and front desk coordination.

We had a booking in here for 5 days from 28th September to 02nd October, 2025. The lady at the reception asked for our ids. We had submitted all our ids but the soft copy of my id had only one side printed. We had already travelled 20 kms from New Palam Vihar, Sector 110A, to enjoy a stay there to participate in the nearest Durga Puja festival in Kendriya Vihar, Sector 56. Since it was a long drive, my husband requested her, that he will drive back to Sector 110A the next morning and submit the hard copy of the id. We had our 15 months old baby with us. Yet, they kept us waiting in the reception and didn’t even offer a glass of water. Is this hospitality you vouch for? This is strictly inhumane and uncouth.Our room number was 409. The services offered were very slow and they didn’t even provide a basic bath mat. Also there was a continuous sound of some sort of stomping on the roof at night which was quite uncanny and uncomfortable. This happened every night during our stay and would stop in the morning. Also, the lady at the reception needs to remember that she is into a hospitality industry, and learn some basic manners while dealing with her clients. She treated us as if we are petty thieves and will flee without submitting our ids. Such an uncouth attitude and audacious behaviour she has! We are absolutely disappointed and humiliated by this gesture of the hotel staff! Will surely not recommend this hotel to any one. Disgusting and hopeless!😞
